messages:
michael: heads up — vendor just confirmed partial RMA arrived in FRA but customs flagged commercial invoice mismatch. forwarder suggests splitting into two AWBs to clear 8 units ASAP and leave 4 in hold. can we accept split? :thinking_face:

priya: how bad is the surcharge to split? also need ETA if we go with 8 vs waiting for all 12.

eric-sales: vendor says they can absorb up to EUR 900 for one-off forwarder fees if we sign-off today. otherwise surcharge ~EUR 1.8k on our side. they can also issue corrected CI but that takes 48h.

olga: depot has room for 8 units this weekend (we planned weekend intake). handling team can do serial reconciliation on Monday. if we split, we need the AWB + manifest right now.

forwarder-bot: new AWBs created by FRA forwarder — ETA to depot if released today: 36h for AWB1, 48h for AWB2. Documents attached (doc refs).

natalie: pls paste AWB numbers here so ops can prebook dock. also confirm insurance and hs-code used on corrected CI.

forwarder-bot: ```
AWB1: FRA1234567890
AWB2: FRA0987654321
Declared HS: 8471.80
Insurance: carrier-insured (CIF) incl. forwarder surcharge
```

priya: if vendor covers EUR 900 we should take the split. waiting 48h for corrected CI risks losing weekend slot and delays to customer onboarding.

michael: agree. decision: accept split, vendor covers up to EUR 900, ops will receive AWB1 this weekend and start intake. hold AWB2 for S/N reconciliation and corrected CI. olga confirm staging + label flow?

olga: confirmed. staging plan: quarantine AWB1 units -> basic power-on + serial audit -> tag to "rma-fra-quick". AWB2 will be routed to FRA depot for invoice fix, then will be cross-shipped to our EU pool.

eric-sales: I'll get vendor to sign cost-cover email right now and ask them to push corrected CI for AWB2. I'll also confirm they accept liability for any additional brokerage up to EUR 900.

michael: perfect. priya please update procurement sheet with delta cost (surcharge covered by vendor but log in notes). assign ticket to eng-infra to flag capacity for Monday.

priya: done — updated sheet and raised infra ticket #INF-4572. tagging @olga for Monday intake ops. :white_check_mark:

michael: thanks all. moving to action: eric to get vendor email, forwarder to release AWB1, olga to prep depot. will close thread when AWB1 received. :rocket:
